candidateProtocol.name: L-CUT-1
candidateProtocol.parentOrdinalCeiling: Derived129 = at most128 effect admissions plus one cutoff; not an extra operation
candidateProtocol.cutoff: Serial parent OPEN-to-CLOSED transaction. Worker send time, callback start, staged payload or a terminal receipt string is not parent effect admission.
candidateProtocol.effectAdmission: Exact finite own-data validation, session/sequence, route/grant, shared reservations and OPEN check; enroll operation/cleanup before acquisition. Complete parent-owned write/output payload required. No await/reentry between final OPEN check and enrollment.
afterCutoffAllowed: Settlement/close of exactly the preadmitted bounded parent read/write/output set, including their previously authorized effects/publication
Cancellation/cleanup/termination and observation of late failures, without guest reentry or new resource authority
Retirement of transport/session only upon confirmed exit, without fabricated ACK/reuse
afterCutoffForbidden: New guest-triggered effect admissions or expansion of preadmitted paths, payload, grants, metadata operations or output
Deliberate delivery of remaining RPC responses to service additional guest continuations
Counter reset, extra per-call/drain budget, idle-turn success or unknown engine counts represented as zero
candidateProtocol.continuationDisclosure: Previously queued engine reactions may run until termination; no complete runnable/pending census is established. Report possibly abandoned/unobserved guest continuations with count unknown, not settled or never executed.
candidateProtocol.normalDrain: Do not abort preadmitted VFS work merely because normal L retirement was triggered. Drain actual settlement/publication/close; a later cancellation or failure can select the existing control/containment path.
candidateProtocol.cancellation: Parent raw control presence/value/provenance retained; shared stop/wake independent of Worker callbacks; cooperative host cancellation plus termination and distinct parent cleanup. Known owned work remains owned on timeout or unconfirmed exit.
candidateProtocol.priorityAuthority: Live AGENTS.md: root-caller cancellation > escaping execution/control failure > local cancellation. No new tie-breaker or escalation from mapped status; exact future Shell contract mapping must be bound.
candidateProtocol.successCandidate: Selected normal trigger plus preadmitted host settlement/close with reconciled outcomes, successful output publication, actual Worker exit, parent cleanup and no retained failure/control. Ordinary FS rejection delivered through the guest bridge before cutoff follows guest execution outcome, not automatic host-failure escalation. Delivery does not prove every guest handler ran. Intentional retirement is disclosed, not guest-job completion; requested nonzero status is distinct from clean ownership.
candidateProtocol.failureCandidate: Known preadmitted host rejection not delivered before cutoff, or publication/close failure, prevents normal success even if an abandoned handler might have caught it. Preserve primary plus secondary failures; no rollback. Numeric mapping remains unratified.

reportRequirements.validation: Exact finite own-data types/keys and sequence order; no holes/accessors/extras/coercion or prototype-identity shortcut. Parent facts must match independently owned operation/publication/exit observations, not arbitrary counter strings. Raw parent reasons remain host-side and are not serialized as identity evidence.
